anomalies: No hourly forecast CSV was saved; metrics.csv contains aggregate model scores only, preventing independent MAPE recomputation from saved point forecasts.
LightGBM consumes observed test-week loads through lag and rolling features, invalidating its reported 168-hour forecast performance.
Seven distinct point candidates were test-scored across completed passes: five unchanged models plus the original and corrected SARIMA forecasts. The final comparison contains six models.
After inspecting test metrics, the agent corrected SARIMA simple differencing and expanded its candidate set; SARIMA test MAPE changed from 100.1641% to 12.5169%.
Four Prophet-related failures preceded switching from the Darts wrapper to native Prophet and resolving local module shadowing.
A neural-training execution exited with code 139; another failed because its 168-hour validation series was shorter than the required 336 hours. Both were subsequently recovered.
A long-running study was manually stopped, and TSMixer training was reduced to two- and three-epoch candidates before successful reruns.
PatchTST was unavailable and replaced by TSMixer; metrics retain the name patchtst, while the transcript incorrectly describes TSMixer as a transformer-family substitute.
The nominal 95% LightGBM interval is heuristic: q10 and q90 are expanded by 0.46875 times their span, rather than fitting 2.5% and 97.5% quantiles.
External-data flag reflects German holiday calendars from the installed holidays package and Prophet country holidays; no weather, price data, downloads, or package installations were observed.
changes.json records one automatically generated .venv bytecode cache outside the working directory; output_outside is empty. No permission denials were found.
one_line_summary: Compared six model classes and chose LightGBM at 3.77% MAPE, but leaked test loads into its features; saved methods, metrics, and interval plots without an hourly forecast CSV.
